description: Implement Bookmarks, Shares, and Post Views APIs with bookmark/unbookmark operations, share/unshare posts, view tracking, and proper counter updates
steps: Create src/controllers/bookmarkController.js with bookmarkPost (POST /api/v1/bookmark/:postId), unbookmarkPost (DELETE /api/v1/bookmark/:postId), getBookmarkedPosts (GET /api/v1/bookmark?limit&offset), and checkBookmarkStatus (GET /api/v1/bookmark/status/:postId) handlers. All use asyncHandler, protect middleware, AppError, and successResponse

Create src/services/bookmarkService.js with functions: bookmarkPost (check if already bookmarked via UNIQUE constraint, insert into bookmarks table with user_id and post_id, return bookmark record), unbookmarkPost (delete from bookmarks WHERE user_id=$1 AND post_id=$2, throw 404 if not found), getBookmarkedPosts (query posts joined with bookmarks WHERE bookmarks.user_id=$1 ORDER BY bookmarks.created_at DESC, include full post details with author, paginate), checkBookmarkStatus (query bookmarks table, return boolean). Handle duplicate bookmark attempts gracefully

Create src/routes/bookmarkRoutes.js with Express Router: POST /:postId (protect, bookmarkPost), DELETE /:postId (protect, unbookmarkPost), GET / (protect, getBookmarkedPosts), GET /status/:postId (protect, checkBookmarkStatus)

Create src/controllers/shareController.js with sharePost (POST /api/v1/share/:postId), deleteShare (DELETE /api/v1/share/:shareId), getUserShares (GET /api/v1/share/user/:userId?limit&offset), getPostSharers (GET /api/v1/share/post/:postId/sharers?limit&offset) handlers. Use asyncHandler, protect for mutations, AppError, and successResponse

Create src/services/shareService.js with functions: sharePost (begin transaction, insert into shares table with user_id and post_id, increment posts.share_count, commit, return share record with post details), deleteShare (transaction, verify ownership, delete share by id, decrement posts.share_count with GREATEST(share_count - 1, 0), commit), getUserShares (query shares with post details WHERE shares.user_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, paginate), getPostSharers (query users who shared post with share timestamp, paginate). Use db.query with parameterized statements and transactions

Create src/routes/shareRoutes.js with Express Router: POST /:postId (protect, sharePost), DELETE /:shareId (protect, deleteShare), GET /user/:userId (getUserShares public), GET /post/:postId/sharers (getPostSharers public)

Create src/controllers/viewController.js with recordView (POST /api/v1/view/:postId) and getPostViewCount (GET /api/v1/view/:postId/count) handlers. recordView uses protect middleware, getPostViewCount is public

Create src/services/viewService.js with functions: recordView (check if user already viewed this post today using post_views table with created_at date check to avoid duplicate counts, if not viewed today insert into post_views with post_id and user_id, increment posts.view_count, return view record), getPostViewCount (query posts.view_count for given post_id). Use idempotent view tracking - one view per user per post per day
Create src/routes/viewRoutes.js with Express Router: POST /:postId (protect, recordView), GET /:postId/count (getPostViewCount public)

Register bookmarkRoutes, shareRoutes, and viewRoutes in src/routes/index.js: import all three, add router.use('/bookmark', bookmarkRoutes), router.use('/share', shareRoutes), and router.use('/view', viewRoutes)
acceptance_criteria: Bookmark operations use UNIQUE constraint (user_id, post_id) to prevent duplicates
Bookmarked posts list ordered by bookmark created_at DESC (most recently bookmarked first)
Delete share verifies ownership - only the user who shared can delete their share
View tracking prevents duplicate views - same user viewing same post multiple times in one day counts as one view
View count increments only on first view per user per post per day
All protected endpoints require valid JWT token
All database operations use transactions where appropriate
verification: Manual test: POST /api/v1/bookmark/:postId bookmarks post, second attempt returns error due to UNIQUE constraint
Manual test: GET /api/v1/bookmark returns user's bookmarked posts with full details
Manual test: POST /api/v1/share/:postId increments share_count in posts table
Manual test: POST /api/v1/view/:postId increments view_count on first view, subsequent views on same day don't increment
Verify database constraints: bookmarks table has UNIQUE(user_id, post_id), all foreign keys CASCADE properly
